name: Aaron P. Walsh
prior_offices: Goshen County commissioner (the official commissioners page lists him on the board; he won a 2022 general-election seat and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Aaron P. Walsh is a Goshen County commissioner and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official commissioners page lists him on the board. The county's salary publications (used here for job titles only) list him as a commissioner. The Torrington Telegram reported that he was one of four Republicans seeking two commission seats in the August 18, 2026, primary. No separate public-record account of his private occupation or education was found in the official pages and other public records reviewed for this Profile.
